name: browse_category
description: Lists the products of a carrefour.it category, page by page. The category ID is the last segment of a category URL: /spesa-online/uova-latte-e-latticini/latte/ -> 'latte'. Returns products with EAN, name, brand, price, unit price and product URL, plus next_start when more pages exist.

cgid.description: Category ID (e.g. 'latte', 'latte-uht', 'frutta-e-verdura'). search_suggestions returns category URLs to take it from.

start.description: Index of the first product to return, for pagination (0, 25, 50, ...). Use next_start from the previous page.

storeId.description: Optional store ID to price the products for; defaults to the store selected in the session.
